Yes, that strikes the right balance — and it's exactly the worry I raised earlier. Because I'd hand-written that title, changing the address didn't just silently overwrite it. It updated the address and the page's own visuals like the icon and preview, but then it warned me that the details could be refreshed and let me decide, and choosing "Keep my title" left my own wording intact.

That's the distinction I care about: when I point a bookmark at a genuinely different page, offering to gather fresh details makes sense, but my own writing shouldn't be thrown away without a say. Letting the automatic refresh be the easy default while protecting anything I've personally written is just right. Good.
